title: Present it
subtitle: The same page is the audience's view, the presenter's window, and the tablet's
bullets: F is fullscreen; P opens the presenter window with notes, a timer, and the next slide
npm run build, then npm run preview, serve a finished deck with no file watching; the built folder goes on any web host
Adding --host to npm run dev puts the deck on your network: open it on a tablet and swipe
Polls from the audience's phones need the live server: see docs/implementation/hosting.md
